name: Otsu (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with a blue roundel enclosing a wave and star motif.
history: The flag of Otsu bears the city's mon (municipal emblem) in the Japanese civic tradition of a single stylised mark on a plain field.

features.role: Otsu municipal emblem — a blue roundel enclosing a wave and star motif
features.symbolism: Lake Biwa at the city's heart
